name: Jersey Shore: Family Vacation
description: The cast of Jersey Shore swore they would always do a vacation together. Now, five years, five kids, three marriages, and who knows how many GTL sessions later, the gang is back together and on vacation in a swanky house in Miami Beach.

videos.title: Road to Vacation: Jersey Shore’s Hottest Hookups
videos.overview: Vinny, Mike, Deena and Pauly count down the 15 hottest Jersey Shore hookups from Seaside to Miami to Italy and back.

videos.title: Road to Vacation: Jersey Shore’s Biggest Blow-Ups
videos.overview: Jenni, Ronnie, Vinny, Pauly and Mike count down the 14 biggest blowups in Jersey Shore history, reliving the best smack talk, smack downs, and all-out brawls.

videos.title: Road to Vacation: Jersey Shore’s Snookiest Moments
videos.overview: Jenni, Ronnie, Snooki, Deena and Pauly count down Snooki’s 15 most hilarious, outrageous, and unforgettable meatball moments.

videos.title: Road to Vacation: Jersey Shore’s Craziest Couplings
videos.overview: As it turns out, EVERYONE fell in love at the Jersey Shore. Pauly, Deena, Jenni, Ronnie and Snooki break it all down in Jersey Shore’s 8 Craziest Couplings.

videos.title: After The Show
videos.overview: Nessa and Josh Peck catch up with Vinny, Ronnie and Nicole, a special guest calls into the show, and Angela from Ex on the Beach drops by to play Never Have I Ever.

videos.title: After The Show
videos.overview: Nessa and Chris Distefano chat with Vinny and Deena about their time in Miami, and Mike calls in to discuss his fight with Ronnie and his proposal to Lauren.

videos.title: Most Jersiest Moments
videos.overview: Mike, Pauly D, Ronnie and Vinny take a look back at the roommates' wildest times in Miami -- including the biggest fights, grossest moments and never-before-seen footage.

videos.title: Jersey Shore: Family Vacation Part 2 Exclusive Sneak Peek
videos.overview: The Jersey Shore cast sits down with Justina Valentine to discuss what's in store in Las Vegas, answer fan questions, reveal candid stories and reunite with a familiar face.

videos.title: A Very Jersey Friendsgiving
videos.overview: The roommates come together at the Jersey Shore Friendsgiving table to look back on all the moments they’re thankful for and all the moments they’re just thankful are over.

videos.title: After Show - Back to the Jersey Shore
videos.overview: Justina Valentine talks to the Jersey Shore Family Vacation cast about Angelina's opportunistic tendencies, Ronnie's baby mama drama and their return to the original beach house.

videos.title: Unseen Moments You Can't Unsee
videos.overview: The Jersey Shore: Family Vacation cast looks back at unaired moments from the show, from Mike's futile fitness journey to Pauly's pranks to Angelina's sexual experimentation.

videos.title: 10 Fist-Pumping Years
videos.overview: To celebrate 10 years of Jersey Shore, the roommates look back at their on-camera hookups, legendary catchphrases, brutal takedowns and drunk spiraling.

videos.title: Road to Vacation: Last Season's Jerziest Moments
videos.overview: The guys look back on Season 3's most memorable moments, including Mike heading to prison, Uncle Nino making a surprise appearance at Vinny's Chippendales' show and Angelina getting married.

videos.title: Road to Vacation: An UnShoregettable Wedding
videos.overview: Mike, Pauly, Ronnie and Vinny look back at Angelina's wedding, from the unpredictable guests to the Italian-style buffet to the girls' unusual speech.

videos.title: The Season Beshore The Season
videos.overview: With an unprecedented amount of new and never before seen footage, Jenni, Mike and Lauren tease their favorite moments from the new season of Jersey Shore Family Vacation as well as reveal all that happened since they left Lake Las Vegas.

videos.title: 12 Days Of Jerzmas
videos.overview: Celebrate the holidays Jersey Shore style with the 12 Days of Jerzmas! From family traditions to never-before-heard stories, Jenni, Nicole, and Mike are sharing their 12 favorite days. Plus, they’ve got a special stocking stuffer for the fans.

videos.title: Jerztory: How Jersey Shore Changed TV
videos.overview: The Jersey Shore roommates changed TV forever, one laundry load at a time. We're hitting rewind & heading back to the boardwalk to hear how the iconic show became a cultural phenomenon.

videos.title: Gym, Tan, Rewind: Jersey Shore Watchback
videos.overview: It’s dirty stay in as the shore mates hit rewind and watch back the very first episode of Jersey Shore. From roasting each others’ outfits, to untold stories about superfans, it’s a look back at their journey from boardwalk to billboards.

videos.title: Deena’s All Star Family Fun Dinner
videos.overview: Deena hosts a family dinner for Jenni, Nicole and Mike where they look back on their Season 6 adventures, reveal which scenes they wish never aired, play party games and more.

videos.title: What's In the Bag?
videos.overview: After five years apart, our favorite guidos are reuniting in Miami for a family vacation, but The Situation’s legal issues have put his vacation in jeopardy.

videos.title: The Ring
videos.overview: Ronnie and Deena’s unresolved issues resurface, and the family is complete with the arrival of The Situation.

videos.title: Sunday Vinday
videos.overview: Ronnie clogs all the toilets in the house, and Nicole and Vinny's past jeopardizes their friendship.

videos.title: Ron Ron Juice
videos.overview: A night of Ron-Ron Juice has the whole house on full tilt, and a French girl at the club has Ronnie questioning everything.

videos.title: About Last Night
videos.overview: Ronnie is in full on spiral mode after a night of epic bad decisions, and Mike has big news to share.

videos.title: Meatball Down
videos.overview: Ronnie has to take responsibility for his actions in the club before his pregnant girlfriend's visit, Vinny searches for the perfect barber, and Deena ruins boys' night out.

videos.title: Baby Mama Drama
videos.overview: Ron's pregnant girlfriend Jenn arrives for an awkward visit, and Vinny is in the doghouse after he grabs a stripper at the club.

videos.title: The Temptation of the Keto Guido
videos.overview: Snooki gets caught stealing from a stripper, Vinny is feeling tempted and might sin, and Pauly D is looking for love.

videos.title: Umm, Hello
videos.overview: While the girls are away, Pauly decides to invite their old roommate Angelina to Miami.

videos.title: Meatball (Training) Day
videos.overview: The girls go off on Angelina when she makes a surprise return to Miami, and Meatball Day gets weird.

videos.title: Angelina Leaves Her Mark!
videos.overview: Angelina's embarrassing bodily mishap leaves a lasting impression on the roomies when she departs the house, and the gang heads to Bimini, Bahamas.

videos.title: JWoww vs. The Proposal
videos.overview: Ronnie is spiraling again, Vinny gets a taste of home, and tension between Mike and JWoww might ruin mike’s proposal.

videos.title: Future Mrs. Situation?
videos.overview: Ronnie tries to sort out his feelings for his pregnant girlfriend, and the roommates get the house ready for Mike to propose to Lauren.

videos.title: The Final Supper
videos.overview: The roommates' final dinner is filled with fun memories and a huge blowup between Ronnie and Mike, and Pauly D runs into a familiar face while he's working.

videos.title: It's Complicated
videos.overview: The gang reunites in Las Vegas to meet Ronnie's baby, but no one knows what to expect when Ronnie's relationship drama gets blasted all over social media.

videos.title: Oh Canada
videos.overview: Vinny and Pauly meet a pair of Canadian women, Jenni calls out the roomies for bailing on her Mother's Day videos, and Ronnie's relationship drama continues to unfold.

videos.title: The Truth About Ronnie
videos.overview: Ronnie is pushed to the edge when the truth about his family situation comes to light, the gang wins big at the casinos, and Jen turns up unexpectedly at the suite.

videos.title: Heartbreak Hotel
videos.overview: Ronnie worries about his baby's well-being when he gets news about Jen, Vinny misses Pauly D while he's out of town, and Angelina shocks the roommates when she pays a visit.

videos.title: Frenemies
videos.overview: Angelina aggressively tries to smooth things over with Jenni, and Vinny misses Pauly so much that he carries around a cardboard cutout of him.

videos.title: The Designation
videos.overview: As their Las Vegas vacation nears the end, Nicole's very extra friend Joey comes for a visit, Jenni leaves the trip early, and Pauly plans a surprise.

videos.title: Four Guidos and a Baby
videos.overview: Nicole and Jenni try to mend their friendship, the guys go baby shopping and revisit the Ronnie and Jen warzone, and Vinny and Pauly make a serious bro-mmitment.

videos.title: Back to Seaside
videos.overview: Jenni and Angelina finally bury the hatchet, and the gang takes a nostalgia-filled trip back to Seaside Heights.

videos.title: Vinny and Angelina: A Love Story
videos.overview: Back where it all started, the roommates enjoy a night back in their original seaside house, but things get messy when Vinny and Angelina air out old dirty laundry.

videos.title: What a Drag
videos.overview: Ronnie makes a surprise appearance at Deena's gender reveal party, and later, everyone heads to Atlantic City for Pauly's DJ gig.

videos.title: Awkward City
videos.overview: In Atlantic City, the roommates do their best to support Ronnie and Jen’s relationship while celebrating at Pauly’s birthday gig, and Angelina continues to flirt with Vinny.

videos.title: Where's the Beach?
videos.overview: As the roommates head back to the Jersey shore, Ronnie and Nicole cut loose before everyone else arrives, and Angelina gets flirty with Vinny after a fight with her fiance.

videos.title: Staten Island Smackdown
videos.overview: Jenni joins Mike for his motivational speech at a rehab facility, Pauly arrives for family dinner, and Angelina pushes Vinny too far in their love-hate relationship.

videos.title: Jewish Barbie
videos.overview: Mike competes in a burger-eating contest, Nicole takes a pregnancy test, and history repeats itself when Ronnie gets into hot water (literally) with another woman.

videos.title: Pork Roll or Taylor Ham?
videos.overview: The roommates come up with an elaborate scheme to kidnap Deena and bring her to the house, while newly single Ronnie takes time to himself to come to terms with his breakup.

videos.title: Wallopin’ in Manalapan
videos.overview: The roommates throw a party with Slip 'N Slides, bounce castles and more, and a night out heats up when a stranger pushes Ronnie to his breaking point.

videos.title: Ronnie Magro's Series of Unfortunate Events
videos.overview: A call from home leaves Ronnie worried and everyone else skeptical, and the roommates help Deena honor her father's memory and fight cancer with a fundraiser.

videos.title: The United States v. The Situation, Pt. 1
videos.overview: As Mike prepares for both a jail sentencing and his wedding, the ladies take his fiancee Lauren to a wedding dress fitting, and Jenni shuts down discussions about her divorce.

videos.title: The United States v. The Situation, Pt. 2
videos.overview: Ronnie claims to have gotten into an altercation in a parking lot, and the roommates gather as Mike receives his criminal sentencing for tax evasion.

videos.title: Secaucus?!
videos.overview: Mike gets sentenced to eight months in prison for tax evasion, Ronnie raises eyebrows with a story about getting mugged, and the gang heads to a dude ranch.

videos.title: Guido Cowboys
videos.overview: During a trip to upstate New York, Angelina and Deena clash over beds, Ronnie reveals that his girlfriend Jen might be pregnant, and Jenni refuses to discuss her divorce.

videos.title: Ranchelor Party
videos.overview: The roommates throw Mike a bachelor party, but the guys and ladies have very different kinds of entertainment in mind, and Ronnie wants Jenni to open up about her divorce.

videos.title: Not Again
videos.overview: Ronnie falls into a funk as his relationship drama looms over the group, the guys choreograph a dance for Mike's wedding, and Nicole prepares for The Snooki Shop's opening.

videos.title: Where's Ronnie?
videos.overview: Deena gets emotional at her baby shower, Mike and Lauren host their wedding rehearsal dinner, and Ronnie's personal woes create tension with the rest of the group.

videos.title: Tuxedo Time
videos.overview: Ahead of Mike and Lauren's wedding, Ronnie opens up to Vinny and Pauly about his relationship problems, and Jenni and Nicole help their daughters prepare for flower girl duty.

videos.title: The Hitch-uation, Pt. 1
videos.overview: It's time for Mike and Lauren's wedding, but all eyes are on Ronnie's unpredictable girlfriend Jen when she makes the surprising decision to attend.

videos.title: The Hitch-uation, Pt. 2
videos.overview: At Mike and Lauren's wedding reception, the guys prepare for their dance routine, Uncle Nino sends Jenn a message, and Pauly D enlists Rob Base to surprise the newlyweds.

videos.title: Goodbye Mike
videos.overview: Mike prepares for his prison sentence, Ron realizes it's time to make changes in his life, Jen's split from Roger goes public, and Deena celebrates the birth of her baby boy.

videos.title: Thirty Days Later
videos.overview: A fresh-from-rehab Ronnie reconnects with Vinny and Pauly, Nicole relishes pregnancy eating, and Jenni confronts Angelina and Ronnie for talking about her divorce on camera.

videos.title: JWoww Gets Her Groove Back
videos.overview: Ronnie throws a birthday party for his daughter, Pauly and Vinny visit Mike behind bars, and Jenni invites her new 24-year-old boyfriend to Las Vegas to meet the roommates.

videos.title: Gym, Tan, Strip
videos.overview: As the roommates arrive in Las Vegas, Vinny is worried his ankle injury will affect his Chippendales gig, Pauly senses a "Ronpage" is looming, and Angelina loses a bet.

videos.title: Tick. Tick. Tick.
videos.overview: Vinny prepares for his big stripping debut, Ronnie's constant texting leads everyone to suspect trouble at home, and the group gets some good news from Mike in prison.

videos.title: Strippendales
videos.overview: Jenni tries to uncover the truth about Ronnie and Jenn, Pauly plans an epic prank, and Vinny makes his Chippendales debut in front of his roommates and mother.

videos.title: The Incident at the Strip Club
videos.overview: The roomies don't know what to expect when Ronnie finds out Jenn joined them at the strip club, and Jenni's boyfriend arrives in Las Vegas.

videos.title: Millennials
videos.overview: Deena has an encounter with a judgmental bar patron, and Angelina is bothered when Jenni's new boyfriend pries into her sex life.

videos.title: Holy Drama
videos.overview: Pauly celebrates the end of Vinny's Chippendales residency with a feast, and looming drama between Jenni and Angelina threatens to upend the baptism for Deena's son CJ.

videos.title: 4 Fists. 2 Bottles. 1 Shore House.
videos.overview: Fingers are pointed, piercings are questioned, and wine bottles are at risk when Nicole and Ronnie get drawn into Jenni and Angelina's feud as Deena tries to play peacekeeper.

videos.title: Last Night Is Cancelled
videos.overview: The housemates spend a day at the boardwalk as tensions linger between Angelina, Jenni and Nicole, and the boys try to have a good time without Mike.

videos.title: Snooki Goes To Washington, Pt. 1
videos.overview: After Lauren tells the gang that Mike's release from prison is being delayed, the ladies head to the White House to ask for help, while the guys let loose in Jenni's new home.

videos.title: Snooki Goes To Washington, Pt. 2
videos.overview: The ladies gang up on Vinny after they return from Washington, D.C., the guys plan an elaborate prank, and the roomies get an update about Mike's release from jail.

videos.title: Only In Jersey
videos.overview: While Mike awaits his release from prison, the roommates take Lauren bowling to get her mind off things, and Jenni gets into a screaming match with an ice cream truck driver.

videos.title: Back to the Jersey Shore
videos.overview: The roommates reunite as Jenni's custody issues threaten her time in the house, Angelina stresses over planning her wedding, and the roommates await Mike's return.

videos.title: Psychic Larges
videos.overview: Nicole invites a psychic medium friend to do everyone's readings, and the roommates celebrate Mike's release from prison with a party at the shore house.

videos.title: Single J-Woww
videos.overview: Mike reunites with the gang for the first time since his release from prison, Nicole plans a divorce party for Jenni, and Angelina gets Ronnie's advice on her wedding.

videos.title: Chicken Cutlets and Ketchup
videos.overview: Angelina finds herself in hot water with Chris after she invites a guy friend to Jenni's divorce party, and Vinny's mom cooks a feast for Mike.

videos.title: The Shorefather
videos.overview: The ladies help Angelina shop for her wedding dress, a backyard calamity leaves Deena inconsolable, and the roommates surprise Mike with a homemade movie about his life.

videos.title: Prenups and Misdemeanors
videos.overview: Angelina gets an education on prenups, the ladies dig themselves out of trouble, Mike gives 24 the third degree, and Nicole and Deena surprise Mike with some special visitors.

videos.title: Unresolved Issues
videos.overview: Angelina's bachelorette party is jeopardized after the roomies see what really happened between Angelina and Zack in Las Vegas, and Pauly, Vinny and Mike plan a guys' weekend.

videos.title: Crash The Bachelorette
videos.overview: Jenni and Angelina clear the air, the guys plot to crash Angelina's bachelorette party in New Orleans, and everyone agrees Vinny is to blame for everything that's gone wrong.

videos.title: Beignets, Blow-up Dolls and Bridesmaids
videos.overview: While the guys are in New Orleans to surprise Angelina for her bachelorette party, Mike reprises his role as The Designation, and Ronnie and Mike prep Vinny for Jenni's wrath.

videos.title: P-Woww
videos.overview: As things get rowdy at Angelina's bachelorette party in New Orleans, Nicole falls asleep at a bar, and Pauly and newly single Jenni wind up in the same bed.

videos.title: So That Happened!
videos.overview: Pauly and Jenni endure an awkward morning after, Mike and Lauren move into their first house together, and Angelina and Chris put the finishing touches on their wedding plans.

videos.title: Rewriting History
videos.overview: The roommates toast Angelina at the iconic Jersey Shore house before dropping by the Shore Store to prank Danny, and Jenni, Nicole and Deena write a raunchy wedding speech.

videos.title: You Had Me at "Um, Hello!"
videos.overview: As Angelina and Chris's wedding day approaches, Jenni suspects the bride's grandmother put a hex on her, and the guys come up with a special dance to surprise the newlyweds.

videos.title: The Speech, Pt. 1
videos.overview: On her big day, Angelina gives bridesmaid gifts to Nicole, Jenni and Deena, Uncle Nino helps Jenni dodge a hex, and the ladies' toast incurs the wrath of the wedding guests.

videos.title: The Speech, Pt 2
videos.overview: After Angelina gets upset at Nicole, Jenni and Deena for their toast at her wedding reception, it's up to Vinny, Mike, Pauly and Ronnie to lighten the mood.

videos.title: The Mediation
videos.overview: Angelina struggles to forgive the ladies after their cringe-worthy bridesmaid speeches, Mike and Lauren open up about their hopes to have a family, and Deena launches a clothing line.

videos.title: Taken Pauly
videos.overview: In the midst of the Covid-19 pandemic, Ronnie moves to L.A., Pauly introduces his Double Shot at Love girlfriend Nikki, and Lauren gets involved in Jenni and Deena's conflict with Angelina.

videos.title: The Double Book
videos.overview: Jenni experiences a medical mishap, Pauly rents a Las Vegas resort for the family's socially distanced vacation, and Deena shows up with Lauren and another surprise guest.

videos.title: Single Ronnie
videos.overview: Pauly and Vinny develop a dating show to help Ronnie find a good role model for his daughter, and the guys reach into their bags of tricks to distract Deena before Angelina's arrival.

videos.title: Trouble Shot At Love
videos.overview: Ronnie gets to know his dating show bachelorettes, Angelina gets a warning from her psychic grandmother, and the guys worry about how to tell Deena that Angelina's arrival is imminent.

videos.title: Jurrasic Angelina
videos.overview: The guys devise a backup plan to surprise Deena and an unconventional strategy for defusing Angelina's wrath, and Angelina gets pranked.

videos.title: The Text
videos.overview: Angelina and Deena question whether to come together on the trip, and Mike doesn't realize he's still on camera while trying to have a low-key text exchange with the guys.

videos.title: Attack Of The Killer Raccoons
videos.overview: The guys devise a plan to get Angelina and Deena to attend a family dinner with Nikki, but the women are hesitant to reunite.

videos.title: Somebody's Wifey's In Town
videos.overview: Nikki comes to dinner, Pauly gives Nikki a list of trigger words to avoid setting off Angelina and Deena, Vinny slips up, and Angelina and Deena finally talk after the wedding speech fiasco.

videos.title: The Return of JWOWW
videos.overview: Everyone is on edge when Jenni arrives in Las Vegas and agrees to a family dinner where she'll finally come face-to-face with Angelina.

videos.title: The Note 2.0
videos.overview: After an awkward family dinner with Jenni and Angelina, the guys enlist Dr. Drew to help them stage a mediation and break the tension between the ladies.

videos.title: Calling Dr. Drew
videos.overview: The guys call on Dr. Drew to help resolve the disputes between Angelina, Jenni and Deena, Deena learns her private chat with Mike was made public, and Mike and Lauren get exciting news.

videos.title: The Wedding Redo
videos.overview: As Nikki and the guys plan a redo wedding for Angelina and Chris, Uncle Nino comes in to officiate, and Vinny prepares a speech for the occasion.

videos.title: The Speech (3)
videos.overview: Angelina and Chris's wedding dinner takes a racy turn, Vinny wears something old to deliver his speech, and Mike and Lauren keep their pregnancy news under wraps until after the reception.

videos.title: Ummm, Hello 2021
videos.overview: The gang is back together and big changes are in the air. Pauly D has a new look, Vinny is looking for a new home, and when social media explodes with rumors about Angelina & Chris's marriage, Mike takes on a new alter ego -The Investigation.

videos.title: The Party's Back
videos.overview: Mike and Jenni step up to help when Angelina's relationship goes south, the family celebrates five years of a sober Situation, and a special guest surprises everyone.

videos.title: The Streets Are Talking
videos.overview: A surprise visit from Nicole makes Mike's soberversary extra special, and Jenni and The Investigation look into controversial rumors about Angelina.

videos.title: Welcome to the Poconos
videos.overview: Deena sets up a family trip to the Poconos, Nicole makes amends while still stirring the pot, and rumors swirling around Angelina threaten the group's vacation.

videos.title: Mr. P
videos.overview: Jenni has a huge announcement. But before the celebration can begin, the roommates must deal with the elephant in the room currently casting a rather large shadow over their Poconos vacation - videos of Angelina and her mystery man in Old Bridge, NJ.

videos.title: Italian Ice
videos.overview: Vinny suffers an unspeakable loss; Angelina confronts Jenni about the videos; and the roommates try their hand at Winter sports.

videos.title: Guido Mania
videos.overview: Vinny tries his hardest to get on Angelina's nerves, Zack prepares the guys for a round of guido-mania wrestling, and a surprise guest is called in to play announcer at the big match.

videos.title: Guido Mania 2
videos.overview: The ladies sit down to enjoy a night of Guido Mania wrestling, Angelina sticks it out to win her bet with Jenni, and Ron's girlfriend Saffire finally meets the family.

videos.title: Guidos on Ice
videos.overview: The girls get to know Ronnie's girlfriend, the couples face off in the first annual Bae Game, Vinny’s reunited with a long lost love, and a Jersey Shore family fun day is about to take a turn when The Investigation returns.

videos.title: Surprise! It's a Snooki
videos.overview: Mike shows Angelina the results of his investigation, Vinny plans a talent show, and Deena kicks off Jenni's birthday celebration, with a surprise appearance from Nicole.

videos.title: The SS Side Piece
videos.overview: There’s a Snooki on the loose, a couple of guidos going down in cardboard boats, and Angelina is about to make a speech. Jwoww’s birthday celebration is in full effect!

videos.title: Worst Talent Show Ever
videos.overview: Jwoww’s birthday celebration is on the verge of going off the rails when Snooki's alter ego Dren RSVPs. Vinny hosts the he first, and possibly the last, Annual Jersey Shore Poconos Talent Show, and tension brews between Dren and Angelina.

videos.title: Best Birthday Ever
videos.overview: A beef between the roomies is upstaged only by an unforgettable talent show hosted by Vinny Guadagnino, featuring an out of this world performance by Snooki, and a speech from Angelina that gives new meaning to the word “bombing.”

videos.title: Medic
videos.overview: With the trip coming to an end, Snooki’s left to clean up the mess made by Dren. meanwhile, Mike plans a second gender reveal even though everyone knows he’s having a boy.

videos.title: The Meatball Day Wrap Up Special
videos.overview: After a whirlwind season in the Pocono Mountains, the ladies of jersey Shore get together for a meatball day where they celebrate all things Season 4 with a drink or two...or ten.

videos.title: Deliveries And Deadlines
videos.overview: New year; new beginnings. Pauly is dusting off the turntables and finally headed back out on tour. Deena's Baby Meatball #2 is almost here, and Mike is ready to officially become “Big Daddy Sitch.” But nothing could prepare him for what happens next.

videos.title: Snooki Vs. The Rock
videos.overview: No longer pregnant, Deena has a meatball day with Snooki. Meanwhile, Vinny is no longer bi-coastal, Angelina is fed up, and Mike is struggling as he awaits the moment he can bring Baby Romeo home from the hospital.

videos.title: Hollywood Shore
videos.overview: Vinny’s realizes there’s no place like home, Mike swaps out the prosciutto for placenta, and a rumor wreaks havoc on the girls’ big West Coast trip.

videos.title: Meatballs Don't Hike
videos.overview: The girls’ trip to Hollywood takes a detour when they learn Vinny sold his house. But before everyone heads back, Vinny is gonna give them an LA experience they’ll always remember but may want to forget because of all the fighting between Angelina & Vinny.

videos.title: Two Baptisms And A Pet Psychic
videos.overview: Pauly D is headed to Jersey for the week, and it’s time for everyone to meet baby Romeo. Meanwhile, Angelina needs clarity about her marriage, so she enlists the help of pet psychic, and The Situation, gets ready for his “Blessification.”

videos.title: The Blessification
videos.overview: Mike feels reborn after being blessified, Angelina is feeling lost after a spiritual reading with a pet psychic, and the roomies get ready for their next family vacation

videos.title: The Not-So-International Vacation
videos.overview: The gang heads out for a family vacation where Mike gets a geography lesson, Jenni is in for a big surprise, and conflict comes from an unexpected place.

videos.title: Deena's Revenge
videos.overview: Pauly D learns how to play bingo, Angelina melts down without her luggage, Mike begins an investigation, and an alarming discovery has the roommates shook.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, Vinny!
videos.overview: Things get heated after the roomies realize they’ve been pranked by Deena. And Snooki arrives just in time for a floating tiki bar, Mike’s freedom party.

videos.title: Best Party Planner Ever
videos.overview: A tropical storm rages; Snooki and Angelina re-enact their famous fight; and the roomies party on a boat that’s also a mansion. Oh, and did we mention the sex therapist?

videos.title: The Sexpert
videos.overview: The Florida Keys get emotional when a sex therapist digs deep into Angelina and Chris’s relationship. Then they get messy when the meatballs create an impromptu late night talk show. And even messier when Mike finds a note from Pauly D.

videos.title: The Lie Detector Test
videos.overview: What truth will be uncovered when, on the last day, the roomies take on a lie detector test? Who will take gold on Wide World of Guidos? And, will Snooki ever find her wine?

videos.title: Livin' La Vida Loca
videos.overview: Mike learns that blondes have more fun, Pauly takes over Madison Square Garden, and group chat is lit when pictures surface of Angelina in Mexico with a man who’s not her husband.

videos.title: Spill The Tea
videos.overview: Angelina tells her side of the story, Jenni and Nicole bribe Deena to spill the tea, and Pauly plans a good, old-fashioned OG vacation. Meanwhile, Mike and Lauren have a difficult decision to make about Mosey.

videos.title: Old Mike Vs. New Mike
videos.overview: The road to El Paso takes an unexpected turn when a bunch of rumors and allegations are given to Mike. And he sends them straight to group chat, where all hell breaks loose.

videos.title: El Paso Pt. 1
videos.overview: The group heads to El Paso for the weekend to watch Pauly spin and join in on some line dancing. It’s love at first bite when Mike eats his first Texas tacos, but it’s anything but love between Angelina and the girls.

videos.title: El Paso Pt. 2
videos.overview: The party continues when DJ Pauly D takes on El Paso and the meatballs take on an owl. But it’s a FaceTime from Angelina that takes Mike over the edge.

videos.title: Messy Mike
videos.overview: Pauly and Vinny jet to Vegas for business and pleasure, Jenni gives a speech in her son Greyson's honor at a sensory needs awareness event, and Angelina fears the old Situation's return.

videos.title: Mike Vs. The World
videos.overview: The messiness finally catches up to Mike. First, in an epic showdown with Angelina and then in an emotional confrontation with Jenni.

videos.title: The Meatball Show
